resolution.catalog_lookup: No page_id named prometeo-mobile was found in catalog/CATALOG_MANIFEST.json. The swarm execution plan defines prometeo-mobile independently as a surface_id.
resolution.target_loop: intent -> page thread -> local planner -> workers -> local steward -> same surface
resolution.do_not_infer: Do not create or promote a second mobile shell/app solely from the logical surface name.

served.publication_evidence: .github/workflows/publish-universal-shell-v5.yml validates manifested bytes, publishes index.html + V5 assets to gh-pages, and verifies live bytes at https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/.
served.human_navigation_rule: Raw child URLs are preview/evidence; canonical human-facing result links remain inside the root Universal Host.

current.current_behavior_summary: The approved tactile selector is the single global control; Favorites, Corner Anchor and page-scoped Notas/Cambios remain in the same Universal Control; canonical results use /?page=<page_id>&changes=<work_item_id>.
current.platform_registry_note: CURRENT_GRAPH revision 17 still points served_current to the older P3 visible-product-set/navigator release. It does not enumerate Universal Shell V5 as a node. This is treated as registry lag or different authority granularity, not permission to relabel either record.
current.catalog_note: Catalog page authorities remain child-page source references; prometeo-mobile itself is not a catalog page.

candidate.important_distinction: A source living under candidate/ is not sufficient to classify its exact bytes as Candidate if SERVED_MANIFEST names that source digest as the served payload. Authority label and exact digest outrank directory naming.

historical.lineage_note: The current lineage graph contains navigator/pagekit/runtime lineage but no Universal Shell V5 node; absence is recorded, not repaired by inference.

non_obvious_findings.finding: prometeo-mobile is presently a swarm surface identity, not a catalog page identity. Its existing product loop resolves through the single Universal Host rather than an independently evidenced mobile application.

The strongest V5 Served proof is the dedicated byte manifest + publisher/live-byte canary, while CURRENT_GRAPH still points to an older P3 served product-set. These records operate at different/stale granularity and must not be collapsed into one inferred promotion.

The exact served V5 source is physically stored under shared/universal-shell/v5/candidate/, proving that path naming alone cannot determine lifecycle state; SERVED_MANIFEST exact digest is authoritative for served bytes.

unresolved_ambiguities: No explicit durable mapping object currently equates logical surface_id prometeo-mobile to a concrete catalog page_id; this return records the evidenced host resolution without inventing such a mapping.

SINGLE_SHELL_HOST_CONTRACT_v1 remains labeled CANDIDATE_RELEASE_GATE even though several of its behavioral invariants are demonstrably served by the manifested V5 publisher. Contract promotion is outside this worker's authority.
LINEAGE_GRAPH does not yet model Universal Shell V5 lineage. No inferred lineage edge was added.

deduplication.decision: No new opportunity emitted: the remaining obvious follow-up classes are already prepared in the universal swarm queue, so adding another would be filler/duplication.
